about.title: about
about.p1: área reversa was born from a simple idea: every public narrative — a politician's speech, a CEO's discourse, a news report, a social media post — is built by someone, with some intention, using certain cuts and omitting others. Our proposal is to do the opposite of the common spectator: instead of consuming the ready-made narrative, we deconstruct it.
about.p2: In posts and podcast we analyze how messages are constructed: what rhetorical structure is at play, what data appears and what disappears, what assumptions are embedded and how the same story changes depending on who tells it. We use primary sources (official documents, transcripts, laws) whenever possible and leave references at the bottom of each content.
about.p3: We are not a partisan vehicle — the method applies to any side of the spectrum. The idea is that, at the end of each analysis, you can see the "toolbox" that exists behind the discourse.
